changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Adds a dedicated guidance_url column to actions, pulled out of the metadata JSONB so it sits alongside code/description as a first-class field.

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Renames actions.metadata to actions.availability. The column no longer needs to be a general-purpose metadata bag: guidance_link moved to the new actions.guidance_url column, leaving only the "what can the user enter relative to availableArea" concern, so the column is renamed to reflect that directly. Shape simplifies from {"available_area_type": "total"} to {"type": "total"}. Every row seeded with guidance_link was also seeded with available_area_type, so the second UPDATE only needs to key off available_area_type. Keys match the snake_case backfill in db.changelog-1.81.xml.
